scale_envelopes.scope: Finite checks of bounds proved uniformly in the note, not full candidate zeros.

residue_identities.scope: Actual main-residue algebra; these hosts need not meet first/main ratios or full equations.

sole_ratio_survivor_exclusion.scope: No full positive86 zero with mu<0 can have this main/first ratio tuple. The enumeration omits transport and first-index restrictions, so excludes their superset; it is not a classification of all negative-input main solutions.

theorem: At every positive86 zero with R<0, mu<0 and X=2^p, Y<2(q^2-1)X^2, and 3p^2-19gp<12g+6 for g=2n-p. Every fixed odd gap has a finite power-branch domain; gaps1 through17 fail.
conclusion: The negative-input power branch has n<p<=2n-19. Low-X data and larger gaps remain open; no universal86 theorem is claimed.
